company_name: Tokyo City University, Integrated System Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The Integrated System Laboratory at Tokyo City University contributes to semiconductor research through its focus on ADC technology.
summary: Tokyo City University's Integrated System Laboratory is engaged in research and development of analog-to-digital conversion technology, emphasizing low-voltage, high-precision ADCs for fine CMOS applications. Their work supports advancements in digital representation of analog signals, which is crucial for various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Analog-to-digital conversion technology for fine CMOS applications
